components.name: Solar Cells (monocrystalline silicon)
components.reasoning: Core photovoltaic conversion element, universally present as the primary functional component in all monocrystalline modules. Typically procured as pre-manufactured wafers from specialized suppliers.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: Front protective layer manufactured by specialized glass companies, providing weather protection and light transmission. Industry standard in virtually all modules with distinct supply chain.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Structural support and mounting interface manufactured by metal fabrication suppliers. Standard in most installations though frameless variants exist for building-integrated applications.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Electrical connection housing with bypass diodes, manufactured by electrical component suppliers. Essential for safe electrical integration and performance optimization.

components.name: Encapsulation Film (EVA)
components.reasoning: Protective polymer layer securing cells between glass and backsheet, produced by chemical/polymer manufacturers. Industry standard though alternative materials like POE are emerging.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Rear protective layer providing electrical insulation and moisture barrier, manufactured by specialty film producers. Common but glass-glass variants replace this component in some premium modules.

components.name: Interconnect Ribbon
components.reasoning: Copper conductors connecting individual solar cells, supplied by wire and cable manufacturers. Essential for electrical series connection within the module.

components.name: Sealant Materials
components.reasoning: Weatherproof sealants and potting compounds from chemical suppliers for junction box and frame sealing. Critical for long-term reliability and waterproofing.
